summary: The proposed patch addresses the described behavior change but may introduce new edge cases and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The patch does not address all edge cases, such as when the default is a callable that returns a unique value each time.
The change might introduce behavioral regression for users who rely on the current behavior when the primary key is explicitly set.
The PR lacks additional tests to cover the new logic, especially for edge cases involving different types of defaults and explicit primary keys.
